title: GTA6 Features Series' First Non-Binary Character, Actor Reveals
description: According to actor Jesse James Rose, GTA6 will feature the first non-binary character in the series' history, a museum curator who cannot be harmed by players.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 to Introduce the Series' First Non-Binary Character, Says Actor Jesse James Rose

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, new details regarding the character roster of Grand Theft Auto 6 have emerged. According to actor Jesse James Rose, who plays a museum curator in the game, GTA6 will feature the first-ever non-binary character in the history of the franchise.

The revelation, covered by gaming outlet Eurogamer, highlights a notable milestone for the long-running open-world crime series. Known historically for its satirical take on modern society and immense player freedom, the franchise is now expanding its character diversity to reflect a more inclusive modern gaming landscape.

### Role of the Museum Curator

Jesse James Rose shared that they portray a museum curator within the game world of Vice City. While deep narrative details remain under wraps, the choice of profession hints at the rich environment and cultural locations players can expect to explore in GTA6.

Notably, the information also indicates that players will not be able to harm this specific character. In traditional GTA fashion, players are given immense freedom to interact—and often wreak havoc—with NPCs across the map. Safe or unharmable NPCs typically tie into specific narrative rules, quest lines, or protected zones, sparking curiosity about what role this museum curator will play in the broader experience.

### Expanding the Scope of Vice City

Rockstar Games has always pushed the boundaries of open-world immersion, crafting living, breathing virtual cities filled with diverse populations. The introduction of a non-binary character with unique interaction rules adds another layer of depth to the sociological makeup of Vice City.

While fans await further official announcements directly from Rockstar Games regarding the full cast and gameplay mechanics, this latest piece of news underscores the evolving nature of game development for one of the industry's biggest franchises.

## Editor's Take

Introducing the franchise's first non-binary character is a significant step forward for representation in Grand Theft Auto. Coupled with the detail that players cannot harm them, this museum curator is bound to play an intriguing role in the world of GTA6. It shows Rockstar's continued dedication to shaping a modern, multifaceted virtual society.
